basic_details.job_title: ZSI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Junior Research Fellow Or Junior Project Fellow, Junior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Zoological Survey of India (ZSI), Southern Regional Centre, Chennai (Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change) has invited applications for purely temporary, contractual fellow posts in the Long Term Ecological Observatories (Arthropods) project: 3 Junior Research Fellow / Junior Project Fellow posts and 1 Senior Research Fellow / Senior Project Fellow post. Pay runs from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 42,000 plus HRA, depending on the post and NET/GATE status. An M.Sc. in Zoology, Wildlife Biology or Biodiversity is required. Applications go by email only to [email protected], on or before 2

The notice prints no date for counting age. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form printed on pages 3 and 4 of the notice, writing the name of the post at the top. It asks for personal details, educational qualifications, experience, computer and GIS expertise, publications, three referees and any other information, followed by a declaration with signature and date.
Affix a recent photograph on the form and self-attest it.
Enclose the documents listed below, together with a No Objection Certificate from the present employer if employed.
Convert the completed form, certificates and enclosures into a single PDF file.

Email the PDF to [email protected] on or before 20 November 2026. The application is addressed to The Officer-in-Charge, Zoological Survey of India, Southern Regional Centre, #130, Santhome High Road, Chennai - 600 028.
The notice does not give a subject line for the email.
Self-attested copies of certificates (School/College such as Transfer Certificate, Mark Sheet, Degree Certificates etc.).
Attested true copies of testimonials of educational qualifications, research experience and proof for date of birth, with copies of mark sheets of all examinations.
Copies of Address and Aadhar card proof.
Evidence documents for the experience listed in the form.
No Objection Certificate from present employer (if employed).
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date are summarily rejected. Incomplete application forms are summarily rejected. Canvassing will disqualify the applicant. The Director, Zoological Survey of India reserves the right to reject any candidature for incomplete information or for any other reason. Selected candidates are required to travel to different field locations for data collection. A false or concealed detail found at any stage leads to cancellation of selection, as the form's declaration states.

content_sections.heading: About ZSI
content_sections.text: The Zoological Survey of India is an organisation of the Government of India under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change. This notice comes from its Southern Regional Centre in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, for posts in the Long Term Ecological Observatories (Arthropods) project. The selected candidates work under the supervision of the Officer-in-Charge of the Centre.

content_sections.text: ZSI has announced 4 vacancies in total. The notice prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Junior posts: knowledge of sampling, data collection, taxonomy and ecology of arthropods. Senior posts: proficiency in statistical GIS software for biodiversity data analysis and species distribution modelling. SC / ST / OBC / Women / PD candidates get age relaxation as per Govt. of India norms. The general instructions mention SC/ST/OBC-Non-Creamy Layer (NCL)/Women/Physically Challenged applicants. The notice prints no date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: ZSI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct novel research on long term ecological monitoring of arthropods in the LTEO sites across India in terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems using integrated approaches. Work on community ecology, stream ecology, GIS and use of remotely sensed data, molecular studies, and responses to environmental stresses in the context of global change. Location of work: (1) Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve (2) Central India (3) Gujarat (4) Western Himalaya (5) Eastern Himalaya (6) Andaman Islands. Maintain, curate and analyse data collected from LTEO sites using relevant statistical techniques and GIS. Prepare scientific and technical reports and manuscripts. Location of work: Chennai.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ZSI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form printed on pages 3 and 4 of the notice, writing the name of the post at the top. It asks for personal details, educational qualifications, experience, computer and GIS expertise, publications, three referees and any other information, followed by a declaration with signature and date. Affix a recent photograph on the form and self-attest it. Enclose the documents listed below, together with a No Objection Certificate from the present employer if employed. Convert the completed form, certificates and enclosures into a single PDF file. Email the PDF to [email protected] on or before 20 November 2026. The application is addressed to The Officer-in-Charge, Zoological Survey of India, Southern Regional Centre, #130, Santhome High Road, Chennai - 600 028. The notice does not give a subject line for the email. Self-attested copies of certificates (School/College such as Transfer Certificate, Mark Sheet, Degree Certificates etc.). Attested true copies of testimonials of educational qualifications, research experience and proof for date of birth, with copies of mark sheets of all examinations. Copies of Address and Aadhar card proof. Evidence documents for the experience listed in the form. No Objection Certificate from present employer (if employed).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted on the basis of their qualification and experience. Shortlisted candidates are informed through email / speed post to appear before an interview committee. The date and time of the interview are informed through mobile number / email. Original certificates must be produced for verification at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ZSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 3 for Junior Research Fellow / Junior Project Fellow and 1 for Senior Research Fellow / Senior Project Fellow.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ZSI fellow posts?
faq.answer: The application must reach [email protected] on or before 20 November 2026. Late applications are summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the ZSI Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: An M.Sc. in Zoology, Wildlife Biology or Biodiversity with at least 65% marks or CGPA of 6.5 in 10-point scale, and CSIR-NET/GATE, as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The limit is not more than 28 years for the Junior posts and not more than 32 years for the Senior posts. SC / ST / OBC / Women / PD candidates get relaxation as per Govt. of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for ZSI Research and Project Fellows?
faq.answer: Junior Research Fellow gets Rs. 37,000.00/- and Junior Project Fellow Rs. 25000. Senior Research Fellow gets Rs. 42,000.00/- and Senior Project Fellow Rs. 28000. All are plus HRA as per Govt. rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, every pay figure in the notice is printed as "+ HRA" as per Govt. rules.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for ZSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form, attach the certificates, convert everything to a single PDF and email it to [email protected]. The notice accepts applications by email only.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on qualification and experience, then called by email or speed post to appear before an interview committee.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The assignment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The initial appointment is for one year, with possible reappointment based on performance.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the Senior Research Fellow work?
faq.answer: The notice gives the location of work for the Senior posts as Chennai. Junior posts work at LTEO sites in six regions, including the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve and the Andaman Islands.
